list.name: engine_type
list.label: Engine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "engine_type", predicate: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}", start: -30d)

list.name: engine_model
list.label: Engine model
list.query:
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "engine" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.engine_model or exists r.engine_type)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if exists r.engine_model then r.engine_model else r.engine_type}))
  |> group()
none = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: "not reported"}])
union(tables: [named, none])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

list.name: vessel_class
list.label: Vessel class
list.query:
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vessel" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "class_name" and exists r.vessel_class)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.vessel_class}))
  |> group()
none = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: "Swiftships USV"}])
union(tables: [named, none])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

import "array"
import "strings"
span = (t) => {
    m = (int(v: now()) - int(v: t)) / 60000000000
    return if m < 1 then "under a minute" else if m < 120 then string(v: m) + " min" else string(v: m / 60) + " h"
}
plural = (n, one) => string(v: n) + " " + one + (if n == 1 then "" else "s")
h = (union(tables: [from(bucket: "telemetry")
      |> range(start: -1m)

      |> last()
      |> group()
      |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
    array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: ""}])])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
role = (union(tables: [from(bucket: "telemetry")
      |> range(start: -1m)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mission_state" and r._field == "control_role" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
      |> last()
      |> group()

  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

since = (union(tables: [from(bucket: "telemetry")
      |> range(start: -1m)

panels.title: Audit log

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "audit" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "message" or r._field == "details")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${category}" == "all" or r.category == "${category}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${search}" == "" or strings.containsStr(v: strings.toLower(v: r.message + " " + r.details + " " + r.user), substr: strings.toLower(v: "${search}")))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "severity", "category", "message", "user", "role", "details"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1000)
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", severity: "Severity", category: "Category", message: "Event", user: "User", role: "Role", details: "Details"})

panels.description: Newest first. Category and Search at the top of the page filter it; the funnel in each column header filters that column. CSV: panel menu > Inspect > Data > Download CSV.

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "audit" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "details" and r.category == "refused")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({reason: if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "read-only") then "read-only account" else if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "ALL STOP") then "ALL STOP latched" else if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "not in control") then "not in control" else if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "changed hands") then "stale (control changed)" else if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "may not command") then "role may not command" else if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "logged-out") then "logged-out session" else if strings.containsStr(v: r._value, substr: "boat link") then "boat link down" else "other", _value: 1}))
  |> group(columns: ["reason"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> rename(columns: {reason: "Reason", _value: "Refused"})

from(bucket: "events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "audit" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and r.user != "-")
  |> group(columns: ["user"])
  |> reduce(identity: {control: 0, logins: 0, refused: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      control: accumulator.control + (if r.category == "control" or r.category == "all_stop" then 1 else 0),
      logins: accumulator.logins + (if r.category == "login" and r.action == "login" then 1 else 0),
      refused: accumulator.refused + (if r.category == "refused" then 1 else 0)}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["user", "control", "logins", "refused"])
  |> sort(columns: ["user"])
  |> rename(columns: {user: "User", control: "Control", logins: "Logins", refused: "Refused"})
